title: Range Sum Query 2D - Immutable
description: Calculate the sum of elements in a rectangle defined by (row1, col1) and (row2, col2) using a 2D prefix sum array for O(1) query time.
pseudocode:
1. pre[i+1][j+1] = matrix[i][j] + pre[i][j+1] + pre[i+1][j] - pre[i][j]
2. sum = pre[r2+1][c2+1] - pre[r1][c2+1] - pre[r2+1][c1] + pre[r1][c1]

steps.note: Initialize prefix sum matrix with padding to handle boundary conditions.
Query sum for rectangle (1,1) to (2,2): Result = 16 - 3 - 4 + 3 = 12.
